title: Ramp-up Quick Journal
content:
Daily micro-journal — quick capture for launch ramp (very rough).

2024-11-07 (Thu) — Sprint ramp notes
09:15 — quick stand: Lina says autoscale tests flaky at 3-4k rps. Marco to repro with fixed seeds.
09:45 — triage with infra: INF-3214 is the socket timeout that bubbles under heavy batching. Workaround: temporary batch size cap to 16 for canary.
10:30 — wrote PRD edit: section 'Rollout -> Canary policy' updated to include:
  - canary duration 48h, min 5% traffic, automatic revert on 3x error-rate increase OR latency p95 + 40%
  - manual gate for enterprise tenants (dedicated traffic never routed to canary)
  - add explicit obs signals: token-cost-per-request, kv-cache-hit-rate, model-fallback-count

Quick to-dos (high priority)
- [ ] Add autoscale test matrix to repo (E2E harness) — owner: Marco — blocker: seed nondeterminism
- [ ] Update billing estimate in PRD (unit economics paragraph) — owner: Priya — need final quant from finance
- [ ] Draft customer-facing rollback note (short paragraph) — owner: Lina
- [ ] Create Splunk/Datadog dashboard tile for per-route token cost — owner: SRE (ask on #sre-ops)

Stakeholder follow-ups (notes to self)
- CS: Jess wants a one-pager on SLA for Dedicated customers — include example throughput bands and expected latency windows. Send by EOD Fri.
- Legal: need to confirm KMS requirements for Private deployment launch checklist (ask security for template).
- Sales: flag that canary does not include multi-region routing yet — callout in launch notes.

PRD editing fragments (rough sentences I want to keep)
- "We will ship Launch-v2 with a staged canary and an explicit performance budget. The budget allocates 70% of expected peak tokens to cached-prefix flows to reduce incremental token cost."
- "Fallback chain: primary hosted model -> quantized variant -> smaller architecture (cost-saver). Fallback is automatic past a soft error threshold; rollback is manual for persistent quality regressions."

Known unknowns / open questions
- how to measure quality regressions automatically for chat flows? (metric proposal: normalized BLEU-like score over curated eval prompts + human spot checks)
- what is acceptable token-cost increase for enterprise customers during rollout? finance threshold = 15%? confirm.
- confirm whether Dedicated customers should ever see canary traffic (likely no) — double-check contract language.

Tiny experiment ideas / scribbles
- orange-button: a one-click revert in Console for the canary route (fast revert + traffic-shift back to stable) — UX: require 2FA for enterprise accounts.
- add a canary label to telemetry so queries can filter by rollout-id (telemetry team: Lina to propose naming).

End-of-day summary (11/07)
- Progress: PRD text updated, temporary batch cap plan agreed, E2E harness request created.
- Blockers: deterministic seeds for autoscale tests; finance numbers for cost paragraph.
- Immediate next: ping finance, drop draft rollback note to Slack for review, set up quick sync with SRE tomorrow 09:00.

Random tiny notes (personal)
- Bring notes to Friday retro: shout out to Marco for last-minute infra swap.
- Keyboard still misbehaving — reorder meeting times to protect deep-write block at 10:30.

-- PRIYA
